messages.content: Can you find me any upcoming rock and jazz concerts for the next month in San Francisco, California and New York, New York?

function.description: Locate upcoming concerts based on music genre in specified city and state. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The city and state to find concerts.

We can pass location "San Francisco, California" or "San Francisco, CA". For New York, "New York, New York" or "New York, NY". The user wants upcoming rock and jazz concerts for the next month. So we need to call for each location with music_genre "rock" and "jazz"? Or maybe we can combine? The function expects a single music_genre string. We could call twice per location: one for rock, one for jazz. That would be 4 calls. But maybe we can pass "rock,jazz" as a comma-separated string? The function description says "Music genre of the concerts." It might accept multiple genres separated by commas. But not sure. Safer to call twice per location.

Thus we will call concert_finder for San Francisco, CA with music_genre "rock" and time_period 30. Then again for "jazz". Then for New York, NY with "rock" and "jazz".
